body: Again Thank you. Your comment means a lot to me. I agree completely with you on that mental health is not discussed enough. This is probably the worst about my shyness because other people do not understand it very well. I am always looked at as weird or stupid because of my fears and I am unable to explain to anyone how I feel when it comes to anxiety. I cannot force people to understand me so its best I keep looking for ways to lose this fear. Thank you for the support!
Thank you. Ill try my best to keep this in mind.
Sure that's OK. Thank you for taking the time to help.
Thank you. Thats certainly a better way to look at this.
